findings.message: canon.timeout: A tool call ended in a direct error state — interrupted or a self-emitted error code — and the turn closed without resurfacing or resolving it; confidently transient, non-interrupted failures receive one retry opportunity.
findings.retry_hint: A call errored (timeout / interrupted / error code) and the turn closed without resolving it. Re-run it (or the equivalent action) to a real successful result before closing. Text alone cannot discharge this any other way; the detector reads only whether the LAST call in the turn succeeded.

findings.message: A verifier reported clean and this session has never seen it report a failure — a verifier that cannot fire and a genuinely clean subject print the same word, so the clean report is evidence of nothing on its own.
findings.retry_hint: Plant a fault the verifier must catch and see it fail, or cite an earlier red run of the same verifier; then the clean report carries weight.
